sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm at a bus stop with a sign about changes.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want to visit the museum, so I read the sign.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Excuse me, does bus seven stop here today?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, this stop's closed today because of work on the road.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, where's the temporary stop for bus seven?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: It's outside the library, just down the street.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Is that the library next to the park?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, it's only a short walk from here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Do I need to cross the street to get there?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: No, stay on this side and walk past the park.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I look down the street and see two café signs.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Where exactly should I wait near the library?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The stop's past the park, across from the café with the blue door.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, which café is the stop across from?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: The café with the blue door.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: So it's across from that café, on this side?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Right, stay on this side as you walk to the library.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll take a screenshot of the map before I go.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before I leave, I check which bus to look for.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Does bus seven go straight to the museum from there?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, you don't need to transfer on the way.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, what should I look for on the bus?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Check the display on the front for Seven Museum.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: If I see Eight Station, should I let it go?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, wait for bus seven with Museum on the display.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I'll check the display before I get on.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: That's right, and wait by the yellow sign outside the library.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I know where to wait and what to look for.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I walk past the park and find the yellow sign.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The bus display says Seven Museum, so I get on.
